topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a tattoo today, a rendition of one of my pieces, inked permanently onto someone's skin. It wasn’t the flattery of imitation that struck me, but a quiet weight in my chest. The colors were off, a bit too vibrant, and the lines lacked the careful, contemplative stroke I’d invested. It was a version of my work, yet it missed the essence, the whisper of intent behind every curve and shade. I found myself wondering how it felt, to carry a piece of my soul, altered, on their flesh. The sky looked a little grayer on the way home.
